  instance_class      = "db.t2.micro"

  name     = "us-west.example.com"
  type     = "A"
  ttl      = 300
  records  = [aws_elastic_beanstalk_environment.us_west_env.endpoint]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "eu_central_record" {

This Terraform program creates an AWS CodeBuild project with an example IAM role and secondary sources. The IAM role is configured to allow access to AWS CodeBuild and S3 buckets. The secondary sources are set up to use GitHub for source code retrieval.

### Terraform HCL Program:

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}

# Define the IAM role for CodeBuild
resource "aws_iam_role" "codebuild_role" {
  name = "codebuild-role"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "codebuild.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

# Attach policies to the IAM role
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "codebuild_policy_attachment" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeBuildServiceRolePolicy"
  role       = aws_iam_role.codebuild_role.name
}

# Define the CodeBuild project
resource "aws_codebuild_project" "example" {
  name = "example-codebuild-project"

  build_spec = <<EOF
version: 0.2

phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - echo Installing dependencies...
      - npm install
  build:
    commands:
      - echo Building project...
      - npm run build
  post_build:
    commands:
      - echo Post-build steps...

artifacts:
  files:
    - '**/*'

cache:
  paths:
    - node_modules/

environment:
  compute_type: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
  image: aws/codebuild/nodejs:14.x
  privileged_mode: false
  environment_variables:
    - name: MY_VARIABLE
      value: "my-value"
EOF

  service_role = aws_iam_role.codebuild_role.arn

  secondary_sources = [
    {
      type = "GitHub"
      location = "https://github.com/example-user/example-repo.git"
      git_clone_depth = 1
      auth_type = "OAUTH"
      oauth_token = var.github_oauth_token
    }
  ]

  secondary_artifacts = [
    {
      type = "S3"
      location = "s3://example-bucket/artifacts"
    }
  ]
}

variable "github_oauth_token" {
  description = "GitHub OAuth token for accessing the repository"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

  family     = "redis6.x"
  description = "Parameter group for Elasticache"

  parameter {
    name  = "appendonly"
    value = "yes"
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "elasticache_auth_role" {
  name = "elasticache-auth-role"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "elasticache.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "elasticache_auth_policy" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonElastiCacheForRedisReadOnlyAccess"
  role       = aws_iam_role.elasticache_auth_role.name

provider "aws" {

    }

  tags = {

  }
}

The program includes default values for the region and assumes the AWS credentials are available via environment variables.

### Terraform HCL Program:

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region || "us-west-2"
}

variable "region" {
  description = "The AWS region where the resources will be created."
  type        = string
  default     = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_s3 Glacier_vault" "example_vault" {
  name = "example-vault"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "example_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:PutVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:DeleteVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:RestoreVaultLock",
      "glacier:AbortVaultLock",
      "glacier:ListVaults",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:ListParts",
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:UploadPart",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
      "glacier:ListJobs",
      "glacier:DescribeJob",
      "glacier:DeleteJob",
      "glacier:ListTagsForVault",
      "glacier:TagVault",
      "glacier:UntagVault",
      "glacier:DeleteTagsForVault",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:glacier:${var.region}:*:*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_glacier_vault_lock" "example_lock" {
  vault_name = aws_s3_glacier_vault.example_vault.name
  policy     = data.aws_iam_policy_document.example_policy.json
}

- **Vault Lock**: The `aws_glacier_vault_lock` resource locks the vault using the policy defined in the previous step. This ensures that the policy cannot be changed without first unlocking the vault.
